name: ipython-core-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is IPython, the interactive Python shell. Its non-interactive core is the
shell engine that runs cells (`InteractiveShell`), the input transformations that turn IPython syntax
into Python, the magic-command system and the built-in magics, the display and formatting machinery,
the history database, object introspection and tab completion. The `IPython` package is imported from
`/workdir` (already on `PYTHONPATH`).

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this part of the repository.
Everything in scope is the non-interactive core of IPython: the modules alias, async_helpers, autocall, builtin_trap, compilerop, completer, display, display_functions, display_trap, displayhook, displaypub, error, events, extensions, formatters, getipython, guarded_eval, history, hooks, inputtransformer2, interactiveshell, logger, macro, magic, magic_arguments, oinspect, payload, prefilter and splitinput under IPython/core, and the magics package IPython/core/magics except its pylab, packaging and script modules, together with their documentation: the module, class, function and method docstrings in those modules, including their examples, the pages docs/source/interactive/index.rst, reference.rst, tutorial.rst, python-ipython-diff.rst, tips.rst, autoawait.rst and magics.rst, and the pages docs/source/config/inputtransforms.rst, custommagics.rst, callbacks.rst, integrating.rst and extensions/index.rst.
